scope: stdlib random complete DFA world generator and observational input exporter only; no solver changes

outputs.world.json: all complete devices, ownership, generation parameters, final states, actual lengths, run counts and statistics
outputs.solver_input.json: exactly alphabet, positive, negative; no generator truth or count constraints

reproducibility.world: seed/K/alphabet-size substream independent of length and sample count
reproducibility.observations: seed/K/alphabet-size/label/candidate-index/event-profile substreams, independent of requested count and length
reproducibility.prefix_repair_length: independent substreams; changing length shares candidate prefix events but can change repairs

review_obligations: verify strongly connected complete conditional model generation and accepting starts
verify active-device BFS repair bound b+min(K,b)*(max_states-1)<=max_length
verify direct short-cap fallback and explicit zero-cap impossible negatives
verify uniqueness, bounded attempts, explicit shortfall and independent label replay
verify observational boundary and nested sample counts across requested2/requested8
verify uniform device/local-event profile and declared skewed weights
review source statically before generation execution; no runtime evidence exists yet
next_gate: theory and auditor hash-bound static review before any generator run
